title: Rank-Aware Independent-Set Counting on Low-Threshold-Rank Bipartite Graphs: A Aether-Continuum Study
topic: The C-3PO Framework: Algorithms for #BIS-Hard Problems on Graphs with Low Threshold Rank
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We investigate the counting of independent sets (\#BIS) on bipartite graphs whose left-side adjacency matrix has low threshold rank. The Aether-Continuum implements a GF(2) rank oracle, a brute-force counter, and a placeholder for a low-rank optimization path. We prove that the rank oracle returns the exact rank of the adjacency matrix over GF(2) and that the brute-force counter enumerates all independent sets correctly. The framework's asymptotic bounds are $O(|V|+|E|)$ for graph construction, $O(n^3)$ for rank computation, and $O(2^{n_{\text{left}}})$ for counting. Static analysis on an AMD EPYC 7763 system yields an AST with 213 SLOC and 18 function blocks. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Chronos-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261102_050124_the_c-3po_framework__algorithm}
